latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editor for Windows.

- Edit, trim, and export MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM videos up to 500MB, all in the browser—no installation required.
- Cloud-based editing on GPU: typical processing time is 1–2 minutes per clip.
- Supports Windows users for quick, straightforward video editing workflows.
- Handles uploads, credits, state, and export via documented API endpoints.
- Provides error handling, status updates, and simple step-by-step instructions for users.
